bonding_level.name: Bonding Level
bonding_level.description: Determines hunter trust, obedience range, and calm composure around aggressive predators like bears and wolves.

following_commands.name: Following Commands
following_commands.description: Controls response speed to Heel, Sit, Stay, and Lie Down. High ranks prevent barking or rustling brush.

blood_tracking.name: Blood Tracking
blood_tracking.description: Level 1-3 tracks heavy, fresh blood. Level 4-6 can follow faint flesh scratches through water, rocks, and rain to stop meat degradation.

search_and_quartering.name: Search and Quartering
search_and_quartering.description: Weaves in zig-zag patterns ahead of the hunter through thick brush to flush upland birds and retrieve small game.
